laws.rule: Private cars are barred, 24 hours a day, from the road to the Lagos de Covadonga (Picos de Europa National Park, near Cangas de Onís) on set days in 2026: 28 to 31 March; 1 to 12, 18 to 19 and 25 to 30 April; 1 May and the weekends of 2-3, 9-10, 16-17, 23-24 and 30-31 May; every day from 1 June to 18 October except 6 June (pedestrians only), the afternoon of 24 July, 25 July and 8 September; 24, 25 and 31 October; 1 and 2 November; and 1 to 8 December. A special bus or shared taxi runs instead: adult bus fare EUR 9 (about A$14.30), children 4 to 11 EUR 3.50, under 3 free; parking EUR 3 a vehicle a day (A$4.77); tickets are bought in advance. Holders of a disability certificate can drive up (not in a motorhome or a vehicle over 5 metres), as can guests with a mountain refuge booking; a restaurant booking does not count. Outside those days the park can add limits if the road or car parks fill. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.

sources.title: Ley Organica 5/1985 del Regimen Electoral General

layers.authority: Parque Nacional de los Picos de Europa (OAPN), Lagos de Covadonga access plan
layers.process: On the busiest days (Easter week, summer and national long weekends) the road to the Lagos de Covadonga is open by public transport only (shuttle from Cangas de Onís), under an annual access plan. The rest of the year private vehicles can use the road, though the park can bring in extra regulation if the road jams. Check the year's dates on the park access page.

zone-requirements.note: Covadonga lakes are in Asturias; Cantabria and Castile and León sides of Picos de Europa not yet checked.
